name: CIBOLA
description: Independent AI-governance MEASUREMENT body. Signed measurement cards over the RFC 9943 substrate. A measurement credential is NOT a certification, endorsement or conformity mark.
featureList: cibola.measure (deterministic GSPC judge, no LLM judges another LLM)
cibola.verify (stranger-verify a signed card with the public key only)
cibola.verify-receipt (SCITT RFC 9943 receipt + card content-id binding)
cibola.export (licensable data product; neutral, never the score)
cibola.license (signed data-license manifest, never from the scored)

offers.name: Verified-measurement subscription
offers.description: Public measurement verification is free; subscribe for continuous domain-specific rankings.

offers.name: Data license
offers.description: Per-dataset data license (licenses measured data, never the score).

register: This is a measurement credential. It is not a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark, and must not be presented as one.
